name: dndgpt-system-rebirth
description: D&D 2024 and homebrew RPG campaigns with ChatGPT as your GM, reusable character sheets and a saved campaign dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Play D&D 2024, Age of Convergence or Sovereign System with ChatGPT as your GM. Create a hero or a party, keep reusable character sheets, and follow a prepared adventure or an original story in an established D&D setting. Track features, spells, equipment, companions, quests and progress in a saved dashboard.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use D&D 2024 unless I choose another game. First help me choose a published adventure or an original premise. After I choose, tailor my character to its setting, tone and starting level: class and species together, then all other choices, with clear explanations. Allow Quickplay, saved characters and revisions. Keep the full sheet in the dashboard.
